title: Security baseline and Memory 2.0
description: Server-authoritative dialogue, bounded provider transport, episodic Memory 2.0, semantic FACT/BELIEF, relationships and world-local persistence became one protected architecture.

description: World, player, villager and village lore received immutable AI-context integration, a server-authoritative revision API and a dedicated operator-only client editor.

title: Installed failures became release gates
description: 0.1.20 ended as a partial PASS with water, grave, identity and latency defects. 0.1.21 then failed at startup on a production-unsafe tombstone Mixin; safe rollback preserved all six persistent hashes and restored service.

title: M11 risk-based production-JAR acceptance
description: PRs #103 and #104 added a 28-scenario risk catalogue, real Fabric GameTests and an isolated exact production-JAR gate. The candidate reached ready state twice, stopped cleanly and preserved six canonical stores across restart; cumulative manual provider and gameplay acceptance remains separate.

title: 0.1.25 exact release and deterministic provider acceptance
description: PR #105 corrected tombstone inventory ownership, PR #107 published the exact production-gated 0.1.25 candidate, PR #108 exercised production Chat, STT and TTS clients against deterministic literal-loopback servers, and PR #109 hardened configuration-cache and release-request gates. These automated scopes do not replace physical Voice Chat, real-provider, focused gameplay or cumulative product-owner acceptance.

title: M11 Phase C shared orchestration deadline — Draft/RED
description: PR #110 at observed head b3172080d89052a5b361d203dbdac152752d7d0d defines the failing contract for one monotonic STT → Chat retries → TTS deadline and exactly-once dialogue and relationship commits. The production orchestration contract is not accepted yet, so this remains active Draft evidence rather than a released capability.

title: Implement Phase C, then run cumulative acceptance
description: Make the shared deadline contract green on one exact artifact, then run real Text/STT/Chat/TTS and Voice Chat, logical two-client lore conflict, focused water and filled-grave canaries, restart and product-owner acceptance before promotion beyond release-candidate status.
